row.notes: (ctx) Gets the current session descriptor (vcall +0xa8 on ctx+0x1030) and maps its mode (+0xc) / session type (+8) to strings: TimeAttack, OvertakeChallenge, CheckpointChallenge, PursuitChallenge, DriftChallenge, AverageSpeedChallenge, RivalDuelChallenge, Elimination, F1CG, F1AMP, Race, Race2, Race3, TimeTrial, AutoCrossChallenge, ShortPractice, Qualifying1..3, ShortQualifying, OneShotQualifying, SprintShootout1..3, ShortSprintShootout, OneShotSprintShootout ('unknown'), formats with Ne_Crt_Snprintf and writes it to a registry node (Vm_Resolve_RegistryNode 0x1461029d0). Callers Sess_Loader_RequestTrackUnload, Game_Championship_ResetSessionsForRestart. Addon: session-type enum names.
